description: This file defines a business event class for loan account lock status within the Apache Fineract project, specifically for the 'Loan Accounts Stayed Locked' event in the context of Centralized Ongoing Batch (COB) processing.

classes.name: LoanAccountsStayedLockedBusinessEvent
classes.description: A business event class that encapsulates the data for a 'loan accounts stayed locked' event within Fineract's COB processing, extending from a generic AbstractBusinessEvent.

methods.name: LoanAccountsStayedLockedBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with specific loan account lock data.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for this event, fixed as 'LoanAccountsStayedLockedBusinessEvent'.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the event, fixed as 'Loan COB'.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns null indicating no specific aggregate root ID associated with this event.
